messages.subject: Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "s")
parts:
Hello,

I am using R version 3.6.3 on a Windows 10 OS, and and getting this error:

Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "s") : File 'C:/Users/djlev/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp6HaOUn/fmesher2a6f824551073.s' does not exist.

I've seen some posts suggesting that INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround() solves their issue; however, it doesn't seem to work in my case. I'm relatively new to INLA so I don't really know how to diagnosis this issue. I was wondering if anyone had suggestions?

Thank you,

Dan
